_comment: Hearthbound: dungeons-and-taverns-3.0.3.f.jar hardcodes this structure's biomes as an INLINE list, so no datapack tag merge can reach it — it generated ONLY in minecraft:swamp, in RU territory as much as in BWG's. Full-file override, identical to stock except the biomes list. a swamp firewatch tower — extended to RU and BWG swamps. Re-derive from the jar with .claude/tools/gen-inline-structure-overrides.js if the mod updates.
